name: Hill and Dale
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #11 — a sawtooth of high and low islands (tops alternating 1080/700) over 600px gaps, teaching diagonal boosted arcs: every hop combines a 600px horizontal crossing with a ~380px up-or-down height change, plus one high central spring throne. Gentle verticality, no hazard.

GEOMETRY: I1 low (trampoline x0..750 top1080) / I2 high (trampoline x1350..2100 top700) / I3 low (trampoline x2700..3450 top1080) / I4 high (trampoline x4050..4800 top700), three 600px void gaps. One central spring THRONE (x2100..2460 top180 h48) hovers 520px above the HIGH islands (700). Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -540..5340, ~540px side runway; bottom y1920 = 712px recovery under the low islands (deeper under the high ones).

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 600px gap in ~0.9s @ ~25 fuel; super 2800 clears all):
- GAP low<->high (three x 600px over void, each with a ~380px height step): the horizontal 600px alone > 527 max spring drift and >> 395 trampoline drift; the added height step only makes it harder. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED at every gap; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB low->high WITHIN a hop: from a low island (1080) a trampoline apex 270 reaches y810 -> 110px below a high island top (700) AND 600px offset. Even the pure climb needs the jetpack. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top180): 520px above the high islands (700). Trampoline apex from a high island reaches y430 -> 250px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: low-island bottom (1208) to bottom blast (1920) = 712px recovery sky (>= 650); the high islands give even more. Verb: FLY.
- Every gap exceeds a spring bounce's reach and the throne sits above spring apex, so flight is required to move up or across. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
